top_risks.title: AI-driven layoffs accelerate
evidence: Amazon, Citi, Dell lead fresh wave of layoffs as AI reshapes jobs in 2026
TCS' FY27 starts with 25,000 fresher offers, the lowest since FY20
Nike announced 1,400 job cuts in global operations
top_risks.recommended_action: Upskill and reskill workforce to adapt to AI-driven changes

top_risks.title: Slowing campus recruitment
evidence: TCS rolls out 25,000 fresher offers for FY27, its slowest start in years
top_risks.causal_chain: AI-led skill gaps → cautious hiring → slowing recruitment
top_risks.recommended_action: Invest in AI-driven recruitment tools to improve hiring efficiency

top_risks.title: AI-led skill gaps widen
evidence: TCS rolls out 25,000 fresher offers for FY27, its slowest start in years, as AI-led skill gaps and cautious hiring reshape campus recruitment trends
top_risks.causal_chain: AI adoption → changing skill requirements → skill gaps
top_risks.recommended_action: Develop AI-driven training programs to address skill gaps

top_risks.title: Regional job market disruption
evidence: Amazon, Citi, Dell lead fresh wave of layoffs as AI reshapes jobs in 2026
top_risks.causal_chain: AI-driven layoffs → regional job market disruption
